episode.title: The Power of Moore's Laws

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Implications of Moore’s Law

episode.tagline: Humanity has progressed more in the last few decades than in all of history before that. Moore's Laws -- yes, we used the plural -- go some way in addressing that, as do a couple of other frameworks shared in this episode.
episode.about: In this episode, you will find mathematical joy, technological wonder and life lessons that are priceless.
